title: Document Viewer block
description: Embeddable document viewer block for component pages. Same fields as document main_page.

openSingleFileDirectly.description: When the block holds exactly one readable file (PDF/image/text/CSV), the landing page opens it straight in the document reader instead of showing a one-row list. Absent means true: pages published before this field existed get the behaviour too.

url.description: Empty string means no file uploaded yet (list-editor placeholder row before the user picks a file).

thumbnail.description: Optional per-file cover image, shown by the renderer instead of the generic document icon. Empty string means none.
